calibration_rule: Encode all four calibration states under original current appearance; require valid source geometry/rendering and future RGB reconstruction MAE <= 5/255. Across all four states, choose the valid appearance level minimizing mean abs(log(mean-two-target appearance latent RMS / original target-motion latent RMS)). Tie breaks toward weaker level. No policy outcome enters selection. Actual AI-assisted visual review is required before selection is frozen.
primary_measure: Target b minus target a EEF endpoint contrast projected onto the initial a-to-b XY axis, with original current/future appearance. Average seeds within state; report tasks separately and an equal-task mean with state-stratified bootstrap intervals.
secondary_measures: future-only appearance effects at fixed target/current image
inference: FastWAM Optional IDM bf16, 10 inference steps, 9 video frames, 32 executed controls, no replanning. Donor input consists only of simulator RGB. Recipient instruction fixed within each task.
stopping_rule: Keep all prespecified candidate states and both reference attempts per state. Exclude a state only before policy inference if either reference fails the unchanged geometry/rendering gates; never replace a failed state. Require both calibration states per task. Require >=4 of the 8 test candidates per task. Run all 192 maximum test controls before any donor branches; stop all donor execution if any baseline/identity/reconstruction gate fails. Reject failed visual codecs before outcomes, preserving full denominators. No silent restart or adaptation after test outcomes.
uncertainty: 16 prespecified test states is a bounded replication, not a powered final confirmatory study. No calibrated task-success equivalence margin is claimed. Baseline limits validate the instrument, not semantic invariance. Norm calibration does not eliminate differences in support or salience.
